fact: A Bill to enact the Zanzibar e-Government Authority Act, 2023, published in the Zanzibar Government Gazette of 7 November 2023, provides in section 27 that the Authority shall establish and manage a data sharing and exchange platform and that public institutions may share data electronically.
title: Bill for an Act to Repeal the Zanzibar E-Government Agency Act, No. 12 of 2019 and Enact the Zanzibar E-Government Authority Act
